title: Scheduled jobs discard the CallResult and log a failed call as sent
method: static-read + live CuraVoice call with unusable credentials
observed_at_discovery: CuraVoice.call() catches every exception and returns CallResult(answered=False, error=...). Observed live: call(to_number='') with bad credentials returned answered=False, error='HTTP 401 error: Unable to create record: Authentication Error - invalid username', and raised nothing. do_morning (cura/__main__.py:275) and do_evening (:285) await that call as a bare statement and then print '[time] Morning check-in sent to <name>' unconditionally. pytest exit 1, 1 failed 1 passed.
